keys.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit target is image 1: the exact orange tabby Jellybean pixel illustration. Supporting pose reference is image 2: one real-cat photo above and a four-paw placement diagram below. Make ONE COMPLETE full-body cat drawing, side profile facing LEFT, on a genuinely transparent background. Change the WHOLE ANIMAL'S walking pose to match the paw diagram, retaining the exact same cat, proportions, facial expression, fur texture, orange stripes, pink loose H harness, ring and fine curved tail of image 1. The dot diagram specifies paw contact positions relative to the grey CHEST/HIP points: orange/red dots are the near-side paws, blue/purple are the far-side paws; floor dots bear weight and elevated dots are lifted. Pose for this frame: The NEAR FRONT paw is on the ground well FORWARD of the shoulder, accepting weight. FAR FRONT paw is planted BEHIND that shoulder. NEAR HIND paw is planted slightly forward of its hip. FAR HIND is trailing BEHIND the hip and just lifting low off the floor. Use the real photo for natural anatomy and weight support; render the same pose with the body and face of Jellybean. Preserve normal curved feline elbow, knee and hock shapes. Subtly shift shoulder/chest weight appropriately; do not freeze the torso. Far-side limbs are slightly darker and partly occluded; near limbs in front must remain visually identifiable. Draw as one continuous animal: NO cutout limbs, seams, rods, rigid-straight sticks, dislocation or extra paws. Keep the approved long narrow ears, plaintive amber eye, pale muzzle, whiskers, lean short-haired body, small soft paws, exact harness and tail. Same camera angle and character scale as input 1, whole cat centered with ample margin. Tail remains relaxed and thin as in the art, not upright like the real-cat photo. No diagram, dots, colored limb bands, text, ground, room, shadow or other items. Return only this single whole cat. IMPORTANT: the explicit near/far paw placements must determine the pose; do not substitute the neutral standing pose.

finalKey4AlphaCleanupPrompt: Use case: background-removal / sprite cutout. The attached complete orange pixel-art tabby cat is already the correct drawing and pose. Remove ALL dark/brown glow, haze and background pixels outside the animal, including between its legs and inside the harness D-ring, leaving clean true transparent alpha. Keep the entire cat exactly as shown: identical full-body left-facing walking pose, identical long ears, slim ginger tabby torso, four complete naturally connected legs, thin curved tail, light pink H harness and metal D-ring. Do not redraw the anatomy, change the pose, change framing, add a shadow, add floor, or add a glow. The near bright hind leg trails lifted backwards; the far dark hind leg is planted forward under the belly. Preserve fine white whiskers, pixel edge outline and fur. Result: one clean full-body cat sprite on genuinely transparent background, with no translucent rectangular or halo residue.
